title: Gelasius of Cyzicus, Acts of the First Council (Nicaea)
english: The minutes of the first council, in three volumes, have been read by me. The book bore the inscription of Gelasius, offered as minutes of proceedings rather than a history. It is a paltry thing, and humble in expression, though it traces what happened at the council in full detail.
translator_notes: Pass A≠B for claim photius-bibliotheca-densify; justification reviews/justifications/bibl_codex_15.json
Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 15 of 279; Gelasius of Cyzicus (fl. c. 475). Bekker Greek (p. 4) presents the book as minutes (πρακτικόν) rather than history (ἱστορικόν); Photius calls the expression paltry yet detailed.
